D: Wayne and Garth try to put on a giant rock festival in Aurora after a vision tells them to.
P: Serve the snacks when Waynestock kicks off.
S: Warm homemade cinnamon sugar doughnut holes, a tribute to the doughnut shop Wayne and Garth always end up at.

Corn cobs charred on the grill and slathered in chilli lime butter, rolled in grated parmesan and finished with coriander and a lime wedge. Mash 60g soft butter with the zest of 1 lime, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of salt. Grill 4 husked corn cobs over high heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred in spots. Brush the hot cobs all over with the chilli lime butter, then roll in 40g finely grated parmesan. Scatter with chopped coriander and serve with lime wedges.
M: the basement studio in Aurora, Illinois

A thick Chicago-style deep-dish pizza layered with mozzarella, Italian sausage and a chunky garlic and oregano tomato sauce on a buttery crust. Press 500g pizza dough into a well-oiled 26cm cast iron pan or cake tin, pushing it 4cm up the sides. Layer 250g sliced mozzarella over the base, then 300g Italian sausage meat torn into small pieces. Simmer a 400g tin crushed tomatoes with 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano and a pinch of sugar for 10 minutes and spread over the top. Scatter with 40g grated parmesan and bake at 220C for 30 minutes. Rest 5 minutes before cutting.
W: Backstage choc cookie ice cream sandwiches

Soft, chewy double chocolate cookies sandwiched around thick vanilla ice cream, with the edges rolled in rainbow sprinkles. Beat 125g soft butter with 150g brown sugar and 1 egg. Mix in 180g plain flour, 30g cocoa, 1/2 tsp bicarb and 100g chocolate chips. Roll into 16 balls, flatten slightly and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Cool completely. Soften 1L vanilla ice cream for 10 minutes, then sandwich a thick scoop between 2 cookies and press together. Roll the edges in sprinkles and freeze for 30 minutes before serving.
K: a hot day at the Waynestock festival

Fresh lemon juice blitzed with frozen raspberries, sugar syrup and ice into a tangy pink slushie, served in big cups with a lemon wheel. Heat 120g caster sugar with 120ml water until dissolved, then cool. Blend the syrup with the juice of 5 lemons, 150g frozen raspberries, 400ml cold water and 3 cups of ice until smooth and slushy. Taste and add a little more syrup or lemon if needed. Pour into 4 big cups and garnish with lemon wheels and a few whole raspberries.

s.how: Mix 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 egg, 150ml milk and 30g melted butter into a soft dough. Roll into 24 balls and fry at 175C for 3 minutes. Toss in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon.
